title: Do stock Markets Price Words or Actions? President Donald Trump´s Geopolitical Signals and Conflict Risk
title_zh: 股市定价的是言辞还是行动？唐纳德·特朗普总统的地缘政治信号与冲突风险
title_primary: 股市定价的是言辞还是行动？唐纳德·特朗普总统的地缘政治信号与冲突风险
title_secondary: Do stock Markets Price Words or Actions? President Donald Trump´s Geopolitical Signals and Conflict Risk
authors: Boris Pastén-Henríquez, Carlos P. Maquieira
official: 官方在线 2026-09-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Geopolitical tensions and military threats increasingly shape global financial markets. Using geopolitical threat signals associated with President Donald Trump, we distinguish between threats that later escalated into military action and those that did not. We find a clear asymmetry in stock market responses. Threats that do not materialize are associated with positive abnormal returns, whereas threats followed by military escalation generate weaker or negative effects, particularly in Latin American stock markets, while responses in G7 economies remain muted. These findings suggest that markets price not only geopolitical threats themselves, but also their perceived credibility and eventual realization, highlighting the role of credibility in asset pricing.
abstract_zh: 地缘政治紧张局势与军事威胁日益塑造全球金融市场。利用与唐纳德·特朗普总统相关的地缘政治威胁信号，我们区分了后来升级为军事行动的威胁与未升级的威胁。我们发现股市反应存在明显的非对称性。未实现的威胁与正异常收益相关，而随后发生军事升级的威胁则产生较弱或负面的效应，尤其是在拉丁美洲股市中，而七国集团经济体的反应则较为平淡。这些发现表明，市场不仅对地缘政治威胁本身进行定价，还对其感知可信度及最终实现情况进行定价，凸显了可信度在资产定价中的作用。

title: Immigration, Trade and Productivity in Services: Evidence from U.K. Firms
title_zh: 移民、贸易与服务业的劳动生产率：来自英国企业的证据
title_primary: 移民、贸易与服务业的劳动生产率：来自英国企业的证据
title_secondary: Immigration, Trade and Productivity in Services: Evidence from U.K. Firms
authors: Gianmarco I.P. Ottaviano, Giovanni Peri, Greg C Wright
official: 官方在线 2015-05-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper explores the impact of immigrants on the imports, exports and productivity of service-producing firms in the U.K. Immigrants may substitute for imported intermediate inputs (offshore production) and they may impact the productivity of the firm as well as its export behavior. The first effect can be understood as the re-assignment of offshore productive tasks to immigrant workers. The second can be seen as a productivity or cost cutting effect due to immigration, and the third as the effect of immigrants on specific bilateral trade costs. We test the predictions of our model using differences in immigrant inflows across U.K. labor markets, instrumented with an enclave-based instrument that distinguishes between aggregate and bilateral immigration, as well as immigrant diversity. We find that immigrants increase overall productivity in service-producing firms, revealing a cost cutting impact on these firms. Immigrants also reduce the extent of country-specific offshoring, consistent with a reallocation of tasks and, finally, they increase country-specific exports, implying an important role in reducing communication and trade costs for services.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了移民对英国服务生产型企业进口、出口及生产率的影响。移民可能替代进口中间投入品（离岸生产），并可能影响企业生产率及其出口行为。第一种效应可理解为将离岸生产任务重新分配给移民工人；第二种效应可视为移民带来的生产率提升或成本削减效应；第三种效应则是移民对特定双边贸易成本的影响。我们利用英国劳动力市场中移民流入的差异来检验模型预测，采用基于聚居区的工具变量，该工具区分了总体与双边移民以及移民多样性。研究发现，移民提升了服务生产型企业的整体生产率，揭示了对这些企业的成本削减作用。同时，移民减少了特定国家的离岸外包程度，与任务重新分配相一致；最后，移民增加了特定国家的出口，表明其在降低服务通信与贸易成本方面发挥重要作用。

title: Dissecting Anomalies in Conditional Asset Pricing
title_zh: 分解条件资产定价中的异象
title_primary: 分解条件资产定价中的异象
title_secondary: Dissecting Anomalies in Conditional Asset Pricing
authors: Valentina Raponi, Paolo Zaffaroni
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper introduces a novel methodology for analyzing anomalies in conditional asset pricing models with time-varying risk exposures and premia. Our approach extends the conventional two-pass methodology to include both ordinary and weighted least-squares estimation in a conditional setting. We establish closed-form standard errors to statistically dissect anomalies, including a version robust to global misspecification. We introduce a novel R 2 criterion to quantify the joint contribution of large anomaly sets in explaining cross-sectional stock return variations. Our analysis highlights the significant impact of anomalies during economic and financial crises, linking them closely with market conditions. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Funding: This project has received funding from the postdoctoral fellowships programme Beatriu de Pinos, funded by the Secretary of Universities and Research (Government of Catalonia) and by the Horizon 2020 programme of research and innovation of the European Union under the [Marie Sktodowska-Curie Grant Agreement 801370]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06968 .
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法论，用于分析具有时变风险暴露和溢价的条件资产定价模型中的异常现象。我们的方法将传统的两阶段方法论扩展至条件环境下的普通最小二乘与加权最小二乘估计。我们建立了闭式标准误，以统计方式剖析异常现象，包括对全局误设具有稳健性的版本。我们引入了一个新颖的R²准则，用以量化大型异常集合在解释横截面股票收益变动中的联合贡献。我们的分析强调了异常在经济和金融危机期间的重要影响，将其与市场状况紧密联系起来。本文由Kay Giesecke（金融领域）接受。资助：本项目获得了Beatriu de Pinos博士后奖学金计划的资助，该计划由加泰罗尼亚政府大学与研究秘书处以及欧盟Horizon 2020研究与创新计划下的[Marie Sktodowska-Curie Grant Agreement 801370]提供资金。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06968获取。

title: Network Rewiring and Spatial Targeting: Optimal Disease Mitigation in Multilayer Social Networks
title_zh: 网络重构与空间靶向：多层社交网络中的最优疾病缓解策略
title_primary: 网络重构与空间靶向：多层社交网络中的最优疾病缓解策略
title_secondary: Network Rewiring and Spatial Targeting: Optimal Disease Mitigation in Multilayer Social Networks
authors: Ozan Candogan, Michael Koenig, Kieran Marray, Frank Takes
official: 官方在线 2025-01-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study disease spread on a social network where individuals adjust contacts to avoid infection. Susceptible individuals rewire links from infectious individuals to other susceptibles, reducing infections and causing the disease to only become endemic at higher infection rates. We formulate the planner’s problem of implementing targeted lockdowns to control endemic disease as a semidefinite program that is computationally tractable even with many groups. Rewiring complements policy by allowing more intergroup contact as the rewiring rate increases. We apply our model to compute optimal spatially targeted lockdowns for the Netherlands during Covid-19 using a population-level contact network for 17.26 million individuals. Our findings indicate that, with rewiring, a targeted lockdown policy permits 12% more contacts compared to one without rewiring, underscoring the significance of accounting for network endogeneity in effective policy design.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个社交网络上的疾病传播模型，其中个体通过调整接触以避免感染。易感个体将连接从传染者转向其他易感者，从而减少感染，并使得疾病仅在较高感染率下才能成为地方性流行病。我们将规划者实施针对性封锁以控制地方性流行病的问题表述为一个半定规划，该规划即使在群体众多的情况下也计算上可行。重新连接行为通过允许随着重新连接率的增加而增加群体间接触，从而补充了政策效果。我们应用该模型，利用包含1726万个体的人口层面接触网络，为荷兰在新冠疫情期间计算最优的空间针对性封锁策略。我们的研究结果表明，在考虑重新连接的情况下，针对性封锁政策相比无重新连接的情况允许增加12%的接触，这强调了在有效政策设计中考虑网络内生性的重要性。

title: Training and Job-to-Job Mobility with Transfer Fees,
title_zh: 培训与工作间流动中的转移费用
title_primary: 培训与工作间流动中的转移费用
title_secondary: Training and Job-to-Job Mobility with Transfer Fees,
authors: Anthony Terriau, Arnaud Chéron
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines the potential impact of introducing a transfer system, similar to that used in professional soccer, into the standard labor market. We develop a toy model highlighting the theoretical properties of transfer fees. We show that, unlike non-compete clauses—which generate a trade-off between training and mobility—transfer fees encourage investment in training while preserving efficient mobility toward more productive firms. As a result, such a system brings the economy closer to the social optimum than laissez-faire. We then construct a life-cycle model featuring endogenous job creation and destruction, on-the-job search, and training. Using data from the French Labor Force Survey, we estimate the model’s parameters and conduct counterfactual experiments. Our simulations suggest that a time-limited compensation mechanism would significantly increase employment, training access, and welfare.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了将职业足球中采用的转会制度引入标准劳动力市场可能产生的影响。我们构建了一个简化模型，以阐明转会费的理论特性。研究表明，与在培训与流动性之间产生权衡的非竞争条款不同，转会费在鼓励培训投资的同时，保持了向更具生产力企业流动的高效性。因此，此类制度使经济比自由放任状态更接近社会最优水平。随后，我们构建了一个包含内生就业创造与毁灭、在职搜索及培训的生命周期模型。利用法国劳动力调查数据，我们估计了模型参数并进行了反事实实验。模拟结果显示，一种限时补偿机制将显著提升就业率、培训机会及社会福利。

title: The Labor Demand Implications of Brand Capital: Evidence from Trademark Transactions
title_zh: 品牌资本的劳动力需求含义：来自商标交易的证据
title_primary: 品牌资本的劳动力需求含义：来自商标交易的证据
title_secondary: The Labor Demand Implications of Brand Capital: Evidence from Trademark Transactions
authors: Jaime Arellano-Bover, Carolina Bussotti, Matteo Paradisi, Liangjie Wu
official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the labor-market effects of brand capital, a demand-side intangible asset that differentiates firms' products. Brand capital is difficult to study because its investments are typically unobserved. We leverage firm-to-firm trademark transfers, which create discrete changes in the ownership of legal rights over established brands. We link the universe of Italian trademark transfers to firm financial statements and matched employer-employee records, allowing us to document how acquiring brand capital affects firm scale, pay, labor composition, and labor shares. In a matched event-study design, trademark acquisitions raise intangible assets by 19%, sales by 8%, and employment by 6%, while leaving average weekly earnings unchanged. Since sales rise more than the wage bill, acquirers' labor shares fall. Employment gains are concentrated in market-facing work, as marketing and sales employment rises roughly twice as much as other employment. More generally, employment growth is concentrated among white-collar and managerial workers. Combining buyers and sellers, trademark transfers increase total sales and employment among transacting firms, and lower their combined labor share. Brand capital thus leads to firms' expansion, shifts labor demand toward market-facing tasks, and provides a micro-level channel through which demand-side intangible capital can lower labor shares.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了品牌资本（一种使企业产品差异化的需求侧无形资产）对劳动力市场的影响。由于品牌资本的投资通常难以观测，相关研究面临困难。我们利用企业间的商标转让——这一行为会导致既有品牌法律所有权的离散变化——将意大利商标转让的完整数据与企业财务报表及匹配的雇主-雇员记录相链接，从而揭示收购品牌资本如何影响企业规模、薪酬、劳动力构成及劳动份额。在匹配事件研究设计中，商标收购使无形资产增加19%，销售额增长8%，就业人数上升6%，而周平均工资保持不变。由于销售额增幅超过工资总额，收购方的劳动份额下降。就业增长集中于面向市场的工作岗位，营销与销售岗位的就业增幅约为其他岗位的两倍。更广泛而言，就业增长集中在白领及管理人员群体。综合买卖双方来看，商标转让提高了交易企业的总销售额与就业人数，并降低了其合并劳动份额。因此，品牌资本推动企业扩张，将劳动力需求转向面向市场的任务，并为需求侧无形资产降低劳动份额提供了微观层面的传导渠道。

title: Walras–Bowley Lecture: Climate Policy in the Wide World
title_zh: 瓦尔拉斯-鲍利讲座：广阔世界中的气候政策
title_primary: 瓦尔拉斯-鲍利讲座：广阔世界中的气候政策
title_secondary: Walras–Bowley Lecture: Climate Policy in the Wide World
authors: John Hassler, Per Krusell, Conny Olovsson
official: 官方在线 2026-07-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We construct a dynamic integrated assessment model of climate and the economy with very high geographic resolution. Migration is free within, but not allowed across, countries. The model parameterization uses a wealth of data, including the distribution of output, population, energy sources and use, and estimates of the local damages from climate change. It implies very large geographic dispersion in damages from warming. We conduct three kinds of policy experiments. In one, we note that a modest, uniform carbon tax limits global warming and damages around the world substantially. In a second experiment, we let the poorest countries not tax carbon, while the rest compensate by setting higher taxes; the efficiency losses are large. In a final experiment, we find that fast green technology growth alone is a poor substitute for carbon taxes, whether globally available or not.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个具有极高地理分辨率的动态气候与经济综合评估模型。模型设定中，人口可在国家内部自由迁移，但禁止跨国流动。模型参数化过程运用了丰富的数据集，包括产出分布、人口分布、能源来源与使用情况，以及气候变化对各地造成的损失估算。该模型揭示了全球变暖损失在地理分布上的巨大差异性。我们开展了三类政策实验：其一，适度的统一碳税能够显著抑制全球变暖并大幅降低全球损失；其二，若允许最贫困国家免征碳税，而其他国家通过提高税率进行补偿，则会产生巨大的效率损失；其三，我们发现，无论绿色技术是否实现全球普及，仅靠其快速增长都无法有效替代碳税政策。

title: Closing the Gap: A LIC’s Policy Options Under an Aid Shock
title_zh: 缩小差距：援助冲击下低收入国家的政策选择
title_primary: 缩小差距：援助冲击下低收入国家的政策选择
title_secondary: Closing the Gap: A LIC’s Policy Options Under an Aid Shock
authors: Dawit Tessema & Sotima J Koussere
official: 官方在线 2026-07-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper uses a structural model calibrated to an aid-dependent economy to analytically explore the macroeconomic and distributional effects of a permanent aid cut under three alternative policy responses: non-concessional borrowing, domestic revenue mobilization, and uncompensated spending cuts. We find that a borrowing-only response leads to unsustainable debt and highly regressive outcomes. An uncompensated cut results in economic stagnation, higher poverty, and adverse inequality. Within the model, a strategy combining moderate borrowing with ambitious domestic revenue mobilization, while painful in the medium term, produces the most favorable path to fiscal sustainability and moderates the rise in poverty and inequality. These findings are analytical and model-based; they illustrate the trade-offs inherent in fiscal adjustment under aid dependence rather than prescribing specific policy actions.
abstract_zh: 本文通过构建一个校准至援助依赖型经济的结构模型，从分析层面探讨了在三种替代性政策应对方案下——即非优惠借款、国内收入动员及无补偿性支出削减——永久性援助削减对宏观经济与分配效应的影响。研究发现：仅依赖借款的应对方案将导致不可持续的债务负担及高度倒退性结果；无补偿性支出削减则引发经济停滞、贫困加剧及不平等恶化。在该模型框架下，将适度借款与积极的国内收入动员相结合的策略，尽管中期内会带来阵痛，却能最有效地实现财政可持续性路径，并缓解贫困与不平等程度的上升。上述结论基于模型分析，旨在阐明援助依赖型经济在财政调整中固有的权衡取舍，而非提供具体政策建议。

title: Not wearing Prada: Do private sanctions reinforce official sanctions?
title_zh: 不穿普拉达：私人制裁是否强化了官方制裁？
title_primary: 不穿普拉达：私人制裁是否强化了官方制裁？
title_secondary: Not wearing Prada: Do private sanctions reinforce official sanctions?
authors: Maxim Chupilkin, Beata Javorcik, Alexander Plekhanov, Aleksandra Peeva
official: 官方在线 2026-07-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Following Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine, official trade sanctions were accompanied by private sanctions: voluntary decisions by firms to reduce or cease supplying the Russian market. This paper examines whether private sanctions curtailed trade beyond official restrictions. We use trademark information to connect transaction-level data on Russian imports with trademark owners’ public statements on their Russian operations. Imports linked to firms announcing private sanctions declined significantly relative to those associated with firms making no such commitments, indicating substantial compliance with withdrawal pledges. These declines also affected goods not covered by official sanctions, broadening the effective scope of trade restrictions, although third-country intermediation weakened the effects. The results are robust to instrumental-variable strategy exploiting variation in investor scrutiny, proxied by public listing status, and imply effects equivalent to ad valorem tariffs of 9–84 percent under plausible trade elasticities. These findings show that public pressure can have meaningful geopolitical consequences.
abstract_zh: 2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后，官方贸易制裁与私人制裁同步实施：企业自愿决定减少或停止向俄罗斯市场供货。本文旨在检验私人制裁是否在官方限制之外进一步抑制了贸易。我们利用商标信息，将俄罗斯进口的交易层面数据与商标所有者关于其在俄业务的公开声明进行匹配。与未作出此类承诺的企业相关的进口相比，宣布实施私人制裁的企业所关联的进口显著下降，这表明撤资承诺得到了实质性遵守。这些下降还波及了官方制裁未覆盖的商品，从而扩大了贸易限制的实际范围，尽管第三国中介效应削弱了其影响。基于投资者关注度差异（以公开上市状态为代理变量）的工具变量策略验证了结果的稳健性，并在合理贸易弹性假设下，其影响相当于9%至84%的从价关税。这些发现表明，公众压力可产生重要的地缘政治后果。

title: Firm Hierarchies and Misallocation
title_zh: 企业层级与资源错配
title_primary: 企业层级与资源错配
title_secondary: Firm Hierarchies and Misallocation
authors: Kehrig, Matthias, Fu, Shipeng
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study how internal hierarchies affect productivity, wages, and labor shares in Chinese manufacturing firms. Using detailed information on professional titles from the 2004 Annual Survey of Industrial Production, we construct firm-level measures of hierarchical structure and compare private firms with state-owned enterprises (SOEs). Private firms operate leaner hierarchies and exhibit rising labor productivity as organizational layers expand. In contrast, SOEs adopt prematurely deep and top-heavy hierarchies associated with declining labor productivity but higher wages. As a result, labor shares are substantially higher in SOEs. Counterfactual exercises show that distortions in hiring and organizational design account for a large fraction of the labor share gap between SOEs and private firms, pointing to inefficient internal organization as an important source of aggregate misallocation.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了内部层级结构如何影响中国制造业企业的生产率、工资及劳动份额。利用2004年工业年度调查中关于专业职称的详细数据，我们构建了企业层面的层级结构指标，并对私营企业与国有企业进行了比较。私营企业采用更为精简的层级结构，随着组织层级的增加，劳动生产率呈上升趋势。相反，国有企业过早地形成了深且头重脚轻的层级结构，这与劳动生产率下降但工资水平较高相关联。因此，国有企业的劳动份额显著更高。反事实分析表明，招聘和组织设计中的扭曲解释了国有企业与私营企业之间劳动份额差距的很大一部分，指出低效的内部组织是总体资源错配的重要来源。

title: Severe Cognitive Impairments and Long-term Care in Germany
title_zh: 德国严重认知障碍与长期护理
title_primary: 德国严重认知障碍与长期护理
title_secondary: Severe Cognitive Impairments and Long-term Care in Germany
authors: Elsa Perdrix, Axel H. Börsch-Supan, Johannes Geyer, Peter Haan, Sami Louahlia
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Germany experiences an increase in LTC recipients, due to population ageing but also to reforms which made LTC benefits easier accessible for individuals with cognitive impairments. Previous studies documented the cost of long-term care, and how it evolved. However, less is known about the specific case of elderly people suffering from cognitive impairment. Thus, we measure the economic costs of cognitive impairment, which include extensive medical, nursing care and at-home long-term care. We use the SHARE, the Survey on Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe, Wave 9. We observe 4% of elderly people living at home with severe cognitive impairment (SCI) (Langa et al. (2017) definition). These individuals are 30% more likely to receive any care, and obtain on average 6 more hours of formal care and 6 more hours of informal care per week. The main driver is not the cognitive impairment per-se but the limitation in activities of daily living (ADLs) which SCI leads to. Thus, once controlling for ADLs, SCI does not explain any additional probability to use care. However, because people with SCI are more likely to have ADLs, the annual cost of their care is estimated to 10,000 euros per year per individual on average.
abstract_zh: 德国长期护理受益人数增加，既源于人口老龄化，也源于改革使认知障碍者更易获得长期护理福利。既往研究记录了长期护理成本及其演变趋势，但针对认知障碍老年群体的具体情况仍知之甚少。为此，我们测算了认知障碍的经济成本，涵盖医疗、护理及居家长期护理等广泛领域。基于欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查（SHARE）第九轮数据，我们发现4%的居家老年人存在严重认知障碍（SCI）（采用Langa等（2017）定义）。这类人群接受护理的概率高出30%，每周平均多获得6小时正式护理和6小时非正式护理。主要驱动因素并非认知障碍本身，而是其导致的日常生活活动能力（ADLs）受限。因此，在控制ADLs后，SCI对护理使用概率不再具有额外解释力。但由于SCI患者更易出现ADLs受限，其人均年度护理成本估计达10,000欧元。

title: Short versus long-run demand elasticities in asset pricing
title_zh: 资产定价中的短期与长期需求弹性
title_primary: 资产定价中的短期与长期需求弹性
title_secondary: Short versus long-run demand elasticities in asset pricing
authors: Philippe van der Beck
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper quantifies how investors’ portfolio demand responds to price changes at long horizons versus short horizons. Using investor trades – changes in portfolios – at different horizons, I first present reduced-form evidence that elasticities increase significantly over time. I then propose a dynamic demand system via a parsimonious partial-adjustment model that recovers the full term structure of elasticities while mitigating long-horizon identification challenges. The estimates imply that price impacts are three times larger at quarterly horizons than in the long-run equilibrium. The model produces a novel, stock-level measure of long-term reversal that avoids the noise of long-horizon return regressions.
abstract_zh: 本文量化了投资者投资组合需求对价格变动在长期与短期不同期限下的响应程度。利用不同期限下的投资者交易——即投资组合变动——我首先呈现了简化形式的证据，表明弹性随时间显著增加。随后，我通过一个简约的部分调整模型提出了一个动态需求系统，该系统能够恢复弹性的完整期限结构，同时缓解长期识别挑战。估计结果显示，价格影响在季度期限上比长期均衡状态下大三倍。该模型产生了一种新颖的、基于个股层面的长期反转度量，避免了长期回报回归中的噪声问题。

title: Satisfaction, Willingness to Pay, and Ridership When Buses Are            Electrified
title_zh: 公交车电动化后的满意度、支付意愿与乘客量
title_primary: 公交车电动化后的满意度、支付意愿与乘客量
title_secondary: Satisfaction, Willingness to Pay, and Ridership When Buses Are            Electrified
authors: Alberto Salvo, Timothy Wong
source: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-03-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Do citizens value the electrification of public transport? Cleaner and quieter services should increase consumer welfare. Yet this response has not been tested, despite the vast investment planned by governments worldwide. We provide a three-pronged empirical analysis of the demand response to bus electrification. First, commuters alighting from electric buses report higher satisfaction regarding noise, fumes, and smell compared with a diesel bus control. Second, residents of a neighborhood exposed to electric buses for over one year are willing to pay US$0.085 for an electric relative to a diesel bus ride, which amounts to US$20 per resident per year. Consumer welfare gains are US$250,000 per electric bus procured—a neglected demand-side cobenefit in public transit’s energy transition that is similar in size to the carbon savings. Third, ridership is higher on electrified bus lines. This effect increases with the timing, duration, and intensity of a bus line’s electrification.
abstract_zh: 公民是否重视公共交通的电气化？更清洁、更安静的服务应能提升消费者福利。然而，尽管全球各国政府规划了巨额投资，这一反应尚未得到验证。我们针对公交电气化的需求响应进行了三管齐下的实证分析。首先，与柴油公交车对照组相比，从电动公交车下车的通勤者对噪音、废气和气味的满意度更高。其次，暴露于电动公交车超过一年的社区居民，愿意为乘坐电动公交车而非柴油公交车支付0.085美元，相当于每位居民每年20美元。消费者福利收益为每辆采购的电动公交车25万美元——这是公共交通能源转型中被忽视的需求侧协同效益，其规模与碳节约相当。第三，电气化公交线路的客流量更高。这一效应随着公交线路电气化的时间、持续时间和强度而增强。

title: Monetary policy under multiple financing constraints
title_zh: 多重融资约束下的货币政策
title_primary: 多重融资约束下的货币政策
title_secondary: Monetary policy under multiple financing constraints
authors: Ander Perez-Orive, Yannick Timmer, Alejandro Van der Ghote
official: 官方在线 2026-07-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A longstanding puzzle in monetary economics is that policy tightening has stronger effects than easing. This column shows that the multiplicity of financing constraints notably dampens the transmission of expansionary monetary policy to firm borrowing and investment, while amplifying the transmission of policy tightening. This asymmetry arises because, when policy tightens, the most responsive constraint binds; whereas, when policy eases, the least responsive constraint limits the expansion of borrowing. A standard New Keynesian framework incorporating this mechanism shows that the decline in aggregate investment following contractionary monetary shocks is twice as large as the increase following equally sized expansionary shocks.
abstract_zh: 货币经济学中一个长期存在的谜题是，政策紧缩的效果强于政策宽松。本文表明，多重融资约束显著削弱了扩张性货币政策向企业借贷和投资的传导，同时放大了政策紧缩的传导效果。这种非对称性产生的原因是：当政策收紧时，最敏感的约束条件生效；而当政策宽松时，最不敏感的约束条件限制了借贷扩张。一个纳入这一机制的标准新凯恩斯框架显示，紧缩性货币冲击后总投资的下降幅度，是同等规模扩张性冲击后上升幅度的两倍。

title: When Nurses Travel: Labor Supply Responses to Peak Demand for Nurses
title_zh: 护士流动时：劳动力供给对护士需求高峰的响应
title_primary: 护士流动时：劳动力供给对护士需求高峰的响应
title_secondary: When Nurses Travel: Labor Supply Responses to Peak Demand for Nurses
authors: Joshua D. Gottlieb, Avi Zenilman
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study how a market uses temporary workers to accommodate extraordinary demand shocks. When COVID-19 surges, hospitals need additional nurses—especially in specialties central to COVID-19 care. By comparing markets for COVID-relevant and other specialties, we show that the market for travel nurses expands dramatically, and we estimate travel nurse labor supply across space. Supply is quite elastic, as workers can choose to travel where they are needed. Workers travel longer distances to temporary jobs when payment increases, suggesting that an integrated national market facilitates reallocation when demand spikes. But when national cases peak, travel distance is less responsive to local demand.
abstract_zh: 我们研究市场如何利用临时工来应对异常需求冲击。当新冠疫情加剧时，医院需要额外护士——尤其是在与新冠护理密切相关的专科领域。通过比较新冠相关专科与其他专科的市场，我们发现旅行护士市场急剧扩张，并估算了旅行护士在空间上的劳动力供给。由于工人可以选择前往需要他们的地方工作，供给弹性相当大。当报酬增加时，工人会前往更远距离的临时工作岗位，这表明整合的全国市场在需求激增时促进了劳动力重新配置。但当全国病例达到峰值时，旅行距离对本地需求的响应程度降低。

title: The Empirical Content of Revealed Preference in High Dimensions
title_zh: 高维显示偏好理论的实证内容
title_primary: 高维显示偏好理论的实证内容
title_secondary: The Empirical Content of Revealed Preference in High Dimensions
authors: Ian Crawford, Longye Tian
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We examine how the empirical content of revealed preference theory depends on the dimensionality of the choice environment. While higher-dimensional choice problems may appear more demanding, we show that revealed preference restrictions become less informative. Using Selten's Area measure, we establish that for any fixed number of observations, the empirical content of GARP converges to zero exponentially fast in the number of goods. We provide complementary proofs based on revealed preference graphs and the Afriat inequalities, and show in simulations calibrated to scanner data that the effect is quantitatively large. We also evaluate potential responses in observational and experimental settings and find that, while these can slow the rate, they do not eliminate this loss of empirical content.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了显示偏好理论的经验内容如何依赖于选择环境的维度。尽管高维选择问题看似要求更高，但我们证明显示偏好约束的信息量反而更少。利用塞尔滕面积测度，我们确立：对于任意固定观测次数，GARP的经验内容随商品数量呈指数级收敛至零。我们基于显示偏好图与阿弗里亚特不等式提供了互补性证明，并在基于扫描数据校准的模拟中显示该效应在数量上十分显著。我们还评估了观测与实验情境中的潜在应对措施，发现这些措施虽能减缓收敛速度，但无法消除经验内容的损失。

title: Crop Insurance and Nitrogen Reduction Under Elevated Fertilizer Prices
title_zh: 化肥价格上涨背景下的作物保险与氮肥减量
title_primary: 化肥价格上涨背景下的作物保险与氮肥减量
title_secondary: Crop Insurance and Nitrogen Reduction Under Elevated Fertilizer Prices
authors: Tsiboe, Francis, Turner, Dylan, Arita, Shawn, Jore, Kyle, Chakravorty, Rwit 等
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The 2026 Strait of Hormuz closure drove fertilizer prices sharply higher, prompting a broad federal response focused on supply-side capacity, logistics, and producer income support. This paper examines the demand-side channel that has received less policy attention: the margin at which corn producers may reduce nitrogen fertilizer application rates in response to elevated input prices. The agronomic literature suggests reductions of 12 to 16 percent are feasible without measurable expected yield loss; this paper examines a more conservative 5 percent scenario. Two features of the Federal Crop Insurance Program, Good Farming Practices standards and the multi-year Actual Production History calculation, may create marginal friction for producers contemplating reduction under shock-price conditions, though neither is likely determinative relative to agronomic and weather considerations. Simulation results suggest a 5 percent reduction across insured corn acres would conserve roughly 300, 000 short tons of nitrogen, raise federal indemnities by approximately $0.10 billion, and leave approved insurance provider returns above the Standard Reinsurance Agreement target. The paper closes by asking whether existing FCIP mechanisms, GFP interpretation guidance, yield-modification provisions, and AIP make-whole arrangements, warrant further examination in the current price environment.
abstract_zh: 2026年霍尔木兹海峡封锁导致化肥价格大幅上涨，促使联邦政府从供给侧产能、物流及生产者收入支持等方面采取广泛应对措施。本文聚焦于政策关注较少的消费侧传导机制：玉米生产者在投入品价格高企时可能降低氮肥施用量的边际空间。农学文献表明，在不造成可测量的预期产量损失前提下，12%至16%的减施幅度具有可行性；本文则采用更为保守的5%情景进行分析。联邦农作物保险计划的两项机制——良好农业操作规范标准与多年实际产量历史计算法——可能对生产者在价格冲击条件下考虑减施行为产生边际摩擦，但相较于农艺与气象因素，两者均不构成决定性影响。模拟结果显示，若参保玉米种植面积统一减施5%，可节约约30万短吨氮肥，联邦赔付额将增加约1亿美元，同时经批准的保险机构收益率仍高于标准再保险协议目标。本文最终提出：在当前价格环境下，现有FCIP机制、GFP解释指南、产量调整条款及AIP补偿安排是否需要进一步审查。

title_zh: 加密货币市场的价格发现：亚秒级证据

abstract: Using transaction-level data for leading digital assets traded on the largest cryptocurrency exchange, we examine trading activity at the 100-millisecond horizon. A disproportionally high trading activity is found during the first 100 milliseconds of a given second in both spot market and perpetual futures. We consider two competing explanations rooted in exchange-level infrastructure versus participant-driven algorithmic trading. Trades executed during the first 100 milliseconds of a second have a significant contribution to permanent price changes after adjusting for the elevated trading intensity during that interval, which is consistent with the notion of algorithmic trading and its leading role in price discovery in the cryptocurrency markets.
abstract_zh: 利用最大加密货币交易所上主要数字资产的交易级数据，我们考察了100毫秒时间尺度上的交易活动。在现货市场和永续合约市场中，均发现给定秒内前100毫秒的交易活动异常偏高。我们考虑两种竞争性解释，分别基于交易所层面基础设施与参与者驱动的算法交易。在调整该时段内高交易强度后，秒内前100毫秒执行的交易对永久价格变动有显著贡献，这与算法交易的概念及其在加密货币市场价格发现中的主导作用相一致。

title_primary: 美国为何没有全民医保？美国医学会的政治角色

authors: Marcella Alsan, Yousra Neberai
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This article examines how the American Medical Association (AMA) helped shape the development of the U.S. health insurance system in the critical period after World War II. Working with the political public relations firm Campaigns, Inc., the AMA launched a nationwide campaign to weaken support for national health insurance by framing it as “socialized medicine,” while simultaneously enrolling people in private health insurance plans to shift demand away from a public alternative. Drawing on newly assembled archival data, we find that greater exposure to the campaign explains about 20% of the rise in private health insurance enrollment and a comparable decline in public support for a national program. The campaign also appears to have influenced policy making through coordinated messaging, resolutions passed by civic organizations, congressional rhetoric, and political donations. These findings suggest that the rise of private health insurance in the United States was not solely due to macroeconomic forces or collective bargaining; rather, it was also enabled by a strategic, interest group–financed effort to shape citizen views and influence policy.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国医学会（AMA）在二战后关键时期如何影响美国医疗保险体系的发展。通过与政治公关公司Campaigns, Inc.合作，AMA发起了一场全国性运动，将国家医疗保险框架定义为“社会化医疗”以削弱其支持度，同时引导民众加入私人医疗保险计划，从而将需求从公共替代方案转移。基于新整理的档案数据，我们发现，该运动对私人医疗保险参保率上升的贡献约为20%，并对国家医保计划公众支持率的下降产生了同等程度的影响。该运动还通过协调信息传递、民间组织通过的决议、国会言论以及政治捐款，对政策制定产生了影响。这些发现表明，美国私人医疗保险的兴起并非仅由宏观经济力量或集体谈判驱动，而是由利益集团资助的战略性努力所推动，旨在塑造公民观点并影响政策。

title: Interdependence of government expenditure among European countries: Productivity spillover and strategic interaction
title_zh: 欧洲国家政府支出的相互依赖性：生产率溢出与策略互动
title_primary: 欧洲国家政府支出的相互依赖性：生产率溢出与策略互动
title_secondary: Interdependence of government expenditure among European countries: Productivity spillover and strategic interaction
authors: Xiaodong Chen, Haoming Mi, Peng Zhou
official: 官方在线 2026-04-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We build an endogenous growth model that distinguishes productive and welfare government expenditures and embeds fiscal externalities. The model yields three testable hypotheses: (i) productive expenditure raises growth (Barro effect); (ii) productive expenditure generates cross-country productivity spillovers; (iii) government expenditure structure exhibits spatial dependence. Estimation with a spatial-panel dataset for 30 European economies (EU27 + 3) corroborates all three hypotheses. We further show that positive productivity externalities induce an international free-rider problem, causing systematic under-investment in productive expenditure, while negative welfare externalities trigger a “welfare tournament” and over-spending on non-productive expenditure.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个内生增长模型，该模型区分了生产性政府支出与福利性政府支出，并嵌入了财政外部性。模型提出了三个可检验的假设：（i）生产性支出促进增长（巴罗效应）；（ii）生产性支出产生跨国生产率溢出效应；（iii）政府支出结构表现出空间依赖性。利用包含30个欧洲经济体（EU27+3）的空间面板数据集进行估计，结果支持了所有三个假设。我们进一步表明，正向的生产率外部性引发国际搭便车问题，导致生产性支出系统性投资不足，而负向的福利外部性则触发“福利竞赛”，导致非生产性支出过度。

title: Patents that match your standards: Firm-level evidence on competition, innovation and growth
title_zh: 符合标准的专利：关于竞争、创新与增长的企业层面证据
title_primary: 符合标准的专利：关于竞争、创新与增长的企业层面证据
title_secondary: Patents that match your standards: Firm-level evidence on competition, innovation and growth
authors: Antonin Bergeaud, Julia Schmidt, Riccardo Zago
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: When a technology becomes the new standard, the firms that are leaders in producing this technology gain a competitive advantage. Matching the semantic content of patents to standard documents, we show that firms closer to the new technology standard increase their market share and sales. In addition, if they operate in a competitive market, these firms also increase their R&D expenditure. Yet, these effects are temporary since standardization creates a common technological basis for everyone, which allows followers to catch up and the economy to grow.
abstract_zh: 当一项技术成为新标准时，生产该技术的领先企业将获得竞争优势。通过将专利的语义内容与标准文件相匹配，我们发现更接近新技术标准的企业市场份额和销售额有所增加。此外，若这些企业处于竞争性市场中，它们还会增加研发支出。然而，这些效应是暂时的，因为标准化为所有参与者建立了共同的技术基础，使追随者得以追赶，并推动经济增长。

title: To Grandmother's House We Go: Informal Childcare and Female Labor Mobility
title_zh: 去奶奶家：非正式儿童照护与女性劳动力流动
title_primary: 去奶奶家：非正式儿童照护与女性劳动力流动
title_secondary: To Grandmother's House We Go: Informal Childcare and Female Labor Mobility
authors: Garrett Anstreicher, Joanna Venator
official: 官方在线 2026-03-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We document how childcare costs and the location of extended family influence the labor supply and mobility of US women. Women return to their home locations immediately before fertility events, suggesting that informal childcare needs may motivate home migration. Women who live near their parents have lower child earnings penalties. We then build a model of labor supply and migration to assess the impacts of childcare subsidies. Childcare subsidies increase earnings and mobility among US women and ignoring migration can understate the welfare benefits of these policies, especially for college-educated women and those whose parents' locations have poor amenities.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了育儿成本及大家庭地理位置如何影响美国女性的劳动供给与流动性。女性在生育事件前夕返回原籍地，这表明非正式育儿需求可能促使返乡迁移。居住于父母附近的女性，其子女带来的收入惩罚较低。随后，我们构建了一个劳动供给与迁移模型，以评估育儿补贴的影响。育儿补贴提升了美国女性的收入与流动性，而忽视迁移因素可能会低估这些政策的福利效益，尤其是对受过大学教育的女性及父母所在地环境条件较差的女性而言。

title: The causal effect of German reunification on economic freedom
title_zh: 德国统一对经济自由的因果效应
title_primary: 德国统一对经济自由的因果效应
title_secondary: The causal effect of German reunification on economic freedom
authors: Vincent Geloso, Kevin Grier, Florence Muhoza
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-01-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Do large changes in electorate composition affect institutional quality? In this paper, we causally consider a unique case of a large change in electorate composition that has no ethnic component: German reunification. As East and West Germans were ethnically similar, the main difference between both groups is tied to cultural differences that arose during Communist rule. We test whether reunification lowered economic freedom (our measure of institutional quality) in Germany using synthetic control methods. We find that there was a transitory effect of less than a decade whereby reunification significantly reduced economic freedom and institutional quality.
abstract_zh: 选民构成的重大变化是否会影响制度质量？在本文中，我们因果性地考察了一个独特案例，即选民构成发生大规模变化且不涉及种族因素的情况：德国统一。由于东德与西德人在种族上相似，两组之间的主要差异与共产主义统治期间形成的文化差异相关。我们运用合成控制方法检验统一是否降低了德国的经济自由度（我们衡量制度质量的指标）。研究发现，统一对经济自由度和制度质量产生了不到十年的暂时性负面影响。
